lines: [softly] Her brothers inherited twelve million dollars. She got one. [pause] One single dollar. And when the lawyer read the number out loud... her brothers laughed.
[softly] Her brothers inherited twelve million dollars. She got one. [pause] One single dollar. And when the lawyer read the number out loud... her brothers laughed.
[voice breaking] They made me feel guilty for buying Dad a better wheelchair.
[calm, a small smile] Jason... that's the first offer you've made tonight that I actually like.
[smug] Don't take it personally, Emily. Dad knew who could actually run a business.
[angry, through his teeth] Sign it over. Or we'll drag you through court until there's nothing left.
[laughs] Hey, Emily. Don't spend it all in one place.
[panicked] I have the emails. I'm not going down for you.
[dry] The buildings are worth twelve, Mr. Carter. The company owes nine of it.
[tired, gentle] Emily... if you're hearing this, I'm gone. [sighs] And I owe you an apology.
[half teasing, half worried] When's the last time you slept more than four hours?
[brisk] Then show me one contract. One invoice. One report they delivered.
